targetText: Let the period of turnover be 5 weeks: the working period 4 weeks, the period of circulation 1 week.
explanation: Capital turnover time consists of production time plus circulation time; reducing turnover time accelerates the annual rate of profit accumulation.

targetText: What these two portions ; the variable and the constant part of the circulating capital ; have in common and what distinguishes them from the fixed capital is not that the value transferred from them to the product is circulated by the commodity-capital, i.
explanation: Fixed capital transfers its value gradually over multiple production cycles (e.g. factory machinery), while circulating capital transfers its entire value in a single cycle (raw materials/wages).
